packages.label: כֹּחַ הַמְדַמֶּה וּשְׁרִירוּת הַלֵּב
packages.label_en: The Imagination Faculty and Stubbornness of Heart
packages.reason: All four nodes are expressions of the same essential evil faculty: the imagination (כח המדמה) that operates in the animal-soul (בהמה), the state of being drawn after it (נמשך אחר המדמה), and its manifestation as the stubbornness of the heart (שרירות לב). These are not cause-and-effect but different names and faces of the same inner evil force that opposes the intellect.

merge_notes.reason: Raw component 3 (edge ID 1483): the animal (בהמה) is an explicit bechina of the imagination faculty (כח המדמה) — both are expressions of the same animalistic imaginative nature.
Raw component 7 (edge ID 3045): being drawn after the imagination is a bechina of stubbornness of heart — same essential state of the person captured by imagination.

merged_nodes: נמשך אחר המדמה / שרירות לב cluster
merge_notes.reason: The two 2-node components share the same essential evil domain: both are about the imagination faculty (כח המדמה) — one names the faculty and its animal-parallel, the other names the human experiential state of captivity to it. Merging by shared nature (not cause-and-effect).

packages.label: שָׁמִיר וּשְׁבִירַת לֵב הָאֶבֶן
packages.label_en: The Shamir and the Breaking of the Stone Heart
packages.reason: These two nodes form the bechina of the positive act of leaving the imagination domain: 'when one exits from stubbornness of the heart and breaks one's stone heart — this is a bechina of the shamir.' The shamir (שמיר) is the essential nature of the act of heart-breaking that defeats the stone-heart. This is a distinct good domain — the capacity and act of self-liberation from imagination — and does not share essential nature with the larger neutral (inner/outer) or good (speech/colors) packages.
nodes: כשיוצא משרירות הלב, ומשבר לבו האבן

packages.label: פְּנִימִיּוּת וְחִיצוֹנִיּוּת — כִּסֵּא וְכָבוֹד
packages.label_en: Inner and Outer Dimensions — Throne and Glory
packages.reason: All five nodes are expressions of the inner/outer (pnimiyut/chitzoniyut) structural distinction that permeates every spiritual level. Kise (throne/כסא) is a bechina of pnimiyut (inner); kavod (glory/כבוד) is a bechina of both chitzoniyut (outer) and levush (garment). These are not polar opposites but two structural dimensions of the same spiritual reality — a neutral ontological framework that applies across both good and evil contexts. The merge of the kise/pnimiyut pair and the kavod/chitzoniyut/levush cluster is justified by the shared domain of the inner-outer structural axis.

merge_notes.reason: Raw component 5 (edge ID 2502): כסא is a bechina of פנימיות (from the Zohar: 'itkas'ya' — hidden/inner). This pair belongs to the inner dimension of the spiritual structure.
Raw component 2 (edges ID 1138 and 1558): כבוד is a bechina of both חיצוניות (outer) and לבוש (garment). This cluster is the outer/garment dimension of spiritual structure.

Both 2-node and 3-node components express the same structural axis of pnimiyut/chitzoniyut that is the Torah's central framework in sections ג–ד. Kise and kavod are the two poles of the same inner/outer reality discussed in the single verse 'כסא כבוד מרום מראשון.' Their shared nature is the structural topology of every spiritual level.

packages.label: דִּבּוּר וּמוֹצִיא מִכֹּחַ אֶל הַפֹּעַל
packages.label_en: Speech and Bringing from Potential to Actuality
packages.reason: All three nodes share the essential nature of actualization through speech: שפתותיך (the lips) is a bechina of מוציא מכח אל הפועל (bringing from potential to actuality), which is itself a bechina of דבור (speech). All three are faces of the same phenomenon — the actualization of inner intellect into expressed form via speech. This is aligned with holiness: it is the Nefet Tzufim dimension of Torah #25, the bringing forth of the sweetness of wisdom.

packages.label: גְּוָנִין עִלָּאִין וְכֶסֶף וָזָהָב
packages.label_en: Supernal Colors and Silver and Gold
packages.reason: These two nodes are a direct bechina pair: the supernal Divine colors (גונין עלאין) are a bechina of silver and gold (כסף וזהב), since the supernal colors are embodied in physical precious metals. This is the Domain of Divine beauty/glory/splendor (פאר וחן) that is revealed when money is in the hands of Israel and given as charity. This domain is distinct from both the structural inner/outer package (Package 3) and the speech/actualization package (Package 4).
